demand: Read Koios-owned assignment, circuit, editorial, provider, publication, attention, and revenue records through their ledger boundary and propose the next bounded newsroom move.
outputs: a digest-bound reading for every observed assignment
one typed proposed move and rationale per reading
refusals: any request to publish, replay work, change provider routes, or amend law
separations: attention and revenue cannot supply factual warrant
provider refusal cannot be classified as bad output
a proposed standards amendment requires an Editor-in-Chief act before execution
